text:
Department of the Treasury
Internal Revenue Service
Notice CP2000
Tax year 2024
Notice date September 21, 2026
Social Security number XXX-XX-1234

Changes to your 2024 Form 1040
Proposed amount due: $1,842.00

The income and payment information we have on file from third parties, such as employers or financial institutions, doesn't match the information you reported on your tax return. This is not a bill.

What you need to do immediately
Review this notice, and compare our changes to the information on your tax return.
Complete, sign and return the response form by October 21, 2026.
If you agree, you can pay online now at www.irs.gov/payments.
If you disagree, send a signed statement and supporting documents. You can upload your response at www.irs.gov/dmaf using access code 895ny-k9654, or fax it to 877-477-9485.

If we don't hear from you
If you don't reply or we can't resolve the discrepancy, we'll send you a Statutory Notice of Deficiency and then a bill. Interest will continue to accrue.

If you have questions, call 1-800-829-0922. Visit www.irs.gov/cp2000.
notes: Written by us from the public template or description at source_url for the false-positive hunt (2026-09-30). Names, numbers and references are placeholders; official contacts are the ones the organisation publishes. Not a verbatim copy of a real message.
